p.small: model selects → harness executes → result returns · parallel calls when independent · schema design = prompt engineering · scale: direct → router → retrieval · failure: retry → different tool → ask user · security: least privilege, allowlist, human-in-loop

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

p.small: working (context) → short-term → long-term → episodic · episodic + reflection = learn from failure without retraining · four patterns: vector, sliding + summary, structured, hierarchical · curation: write, read, update, forget

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

p.small: host → client → server (one protocol) · tools (model) + resources (app) + prompts (user) · stdio (local) or HTTP + SSE (remote) · N×M → N+M
